channel.title: Evostackr — Products & Software Engineering
channel.description: Official product releases, engineering updates, and software developments from Evostackr.

item.title: SMS Campaign Manager — Dual-SIM Bulk SMS Dispatch Engine for Android
item.description: Turn any Android phone into an automated, private bulk SMS dispatch engine with Dual-SIM support, intelligent rate-limiting, and zero third-party gateway markups. Built using native Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and persistent Foreground Services.

item.title: Fabricate — Product Incubation Studio for Startups
item.description: A venture studio that selects promising startup ideas and engineers them into functional web and mobile applications at zero initial development cost.

item.title: WhatsApp Past Member Extractor — Browser Group Analytics & Export Tool
item.description: Client-side browser utility that safely extracts and exports past participants who left or were removed from WhatsApp Web groups into CSV, Excel, and VCF formats.

item.title: 24IDChat — Ephemeral Anonymous Messaging Platform
item.description: High-speed real-time anonymous chat rooms powered by unique 24-hour disposable identities, sub-15ms WebSocket delivery, and self-purging message streams with zero data logging.

item.title: TempEmailFree — Instant Disposable Email Generator with OTP Detection
item.description: Instant, secure, and disposable temporary email service featuring real-time inbox auto-refresh and algorithmic OTP verification code detection.

item.title: Custom Software Engineering & SaaS Platform Architecture
item.description: Evostackr provides custom website engineering, complex web application development, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, business workflow automation, and custom API integrations for clients worldwide.
